description:
Change an agent wallet's session permission mode (non-custodial control plane).

Ports Claude Code's plan/acceptEdits/bypassPermissions ladder to a wallet
with signing power. mode: observe (deny every mutating tool outright,
PERMISSION_MODE_BLOCKED) | propose (mutating tools return a PROPOSAL
envelope -- proposal_id + params + summary -- instead of executing;
approve within the TTL via approve_proposal) | auto_within_policy (execute
immediately, still capped by every configured WalletPolicy -- the pre-R9
default). Also settable inline via set_wallet_policy's permission_mode
param. The transition is logged as an AgentTransaction audit row.
name: set_permission_mode
